title: ProcSense: whole live pipeline
subtitle: Learner profile → AI scenario plan → numbers and media → validation and repair → package → simulation → debrief → history → offline feedback. Planning only.

nodes.label: LG-01
nodes.title: Session request
nodes.text: Partly built. Unity or the CLI asks for a session: trainee pseudonym, mode (practice only for generated cases), scenario family (S1 or S2)… Plans: A2.

nodes.label: LG-02
nodes.title: Learning objectives and difficulty target
nodes.text: Built. Turn the trainee's history into objectives: the weakest behaviours and dimensions from the Elo ratings, the target difficulty… Plans: A2, A11, D43, D44.

nodes.label: LG-03
nodes.title: Context retrieval
nodes.text: Built. Retrieve the evidence the scenario may draw on: candidate blocks matching the objectives, reference cases with similar structure, bands… Plans: A2, E58.

nodes.label: LG-04
nodes.title: AI plan composer + constraint solver
nodes.text: Planned. The AI composer (LLM with retrieval over the scenario knowledge base and exemplar cases… Plans: A1, A2, A3, A4.

nodes.label: LG-05
nodes.title: Scenario skeleton
nodes.text: Built. Assemble the chosen blocks into a case-file-shaped skeleton: patient slots, problems with their discovery rules, investigation orders that must exist… Plans: A1, A2, B23.

nodes.label: LG-06
nodes.title: AI narrative, profile and persona
nodes.text: Blocked. A served LLM fills the narrative slots only: presenting story in the patient's words, social context, persona traits, staff handover wording… Plans: A1, A2, A3, A7.

nodes.label: LG-07
nodes.title: Numeric generation (labs, vitals, trends)
nodes.text: Partly built. Fill every numeric slot: lab results per analyte conditioned on the case's conditions, vital-sign baselines and trajectories… Plans: A2, B14, B20, B21.

nodes.label: LG-08
nodes.title: Image and waveform handling
nodes.text: Partly built. Pick, for every imaging and ECG slot, an asset whose finding tags match the skeleton (real first… Plans: A2, B15, B16, B17.

nodes.label: LG-09
nodes.title: Cross-modal consistency
nodes.text: Partly built. Check that every modality tells the same story: ECG rhythm against pulse and monitor; ultrasound findings against inflammatory markers… Plans: A2, A4, A10, B18.

nodes.label: LG-10
nodes.title: Stage B validation (clinical safety)
nodes.text: Partly built. Run the existing Stage B checks (11 ordered checks, 12 contradiction types) and the Core ContentGate on the full package. Plans: A1, A2, A4, A10.

nodes.label: LG-11
nodes.title: Quality evaluation
nodes.text: Partly built. Score a valid scenario for teaching quality: objective coverage, difficulty match, discoverability of every problem, distractor fairness… Plans: A2, A7, A9.

nodes.label: LG-12
nodes.title: Repair, regeneration or rejection
nodes.text: Built. Fix defects at the cheapest level: redraw a numeric slot, swap an asset, swap a block, re-ask the LLM with the defect as an avoid-hint. Plans: A2, A10.

nodes.label: LG-13
nodes.title: Novelty check (fingerprint)
nodes.text: Built. Build the structured fingerprint (structural, clinical and surface levels) and compare it with this trainee's recent sessions and the library. Plans: A2, A6.

nodes.label: LG-14
nodes.title: Packaging with provenance
nodes.text: Proposed. Write the Scenario Package: case file, generated values, asset references, narrative, solver trace, fingerprint, quality and novelty reports, seed… Plans: A2, A13.

nodes.label: LG-15
nodes.title: Unity integration
nodes.text: Planned. Unity fetches the package (or reads one from the pre-generated pool on disk), the C# loader validates schema, hash and review status… Plans: A2.

nodes.label: LG-16
nodes.title: Live simulation
nodes.text: Built. The deterministic Core runs the case: SimClock in 0.5 s steps, subsystems, LitePhysio, EventDirector (seeded draw in practice), discovery, sepsis… Plans: A2, A5, A8, E48.

nodes.label: LG-17
nodes.title: Action interpretation
nodes.text: Partly built. Turn what the trainee did into structured actions: VR interactions and menu choices map deterministically… Plans: A2, C24, C31, C32.

nodes.label: LG-18
nodes.title: Deterministic state update and scoring
nodes.text: Built. Rules decide every state change, every credit and penalty, the outcome and the fail gate (ADR-0005). Plans: A2, A8, C35, C36.

nodes.label: LG-19
nodes.title: Grounded debrief
nodes.text: Partly built. Template debrief from DebriefFacts is always produced first (built). Plans: A2, B22, D38, D39.

nodes.label: LG-20
nodes.title: Session history
nodes.text: Partly built. Store the pseudonymised session record: scores, ratings update, fingerprint of the generated case, package hash, debrief facts. Plans: A2, D40, D41, D42.

nodes.label: LG-21
nodes.title: Evaluation feedback loop (offline only)
nodes.text: Proposed. Aggregate rejection reasons, repair rates, novelty, quality scores, trainee outcomes and validator escapes across sessions. Plans: A2, D40, E51, E55.

nodes.label: LP-01
nodes.title: Learner profile retrieval (session start)
nodes.text: Proposed. Load the trainee's LearnerProfile v1 (posteriors, demonstrated weaknesses, hypotheses, trends, recent fingerprints). Plans: D67.

nodes.label: LP-02
nodes.title: Learner profile update (post-session, cheap)
nodes.text: Proposed. Extract SessionEvidence v1, update posteriors and pattern status; the LLM interpreter adds hypotheses offline. Plans: D67.

nodes.label: LP-03
nodes.title: Personalised targeting policy
nodes.text: Proposed. Turn the profile into Objectives v1 (rules, later a contextual bandit adopted after off-policy evaluation) and the why-this-case facts. Plans: D68.

nodes.label: ENTRY-TRAINEE
nodes.title: Trainee starts a practice session
nodes.text: Partly built. The trainee (or the trainer) asks for a session in Unity or the CLI. Plans: A2.

nodes.label: ENTRY-AUTHOR
nodes.title: Offline batch run by a content author
nodes.text: Planned. An author runs the offline preparation and the batch evaluator (no trainee present). Plans: A2.

nodes.label: EXIT-SESSION-REPORT
nodes.title: Session report and history saved
nodes.text: Partly built. The JSON and HTML report plus the pseudonymised history entry. Plans: A2.

nodes.label: EXIT-OFFLINE-RELEASE
nodes.title: Reviewed offline release
nodes.text: Planned. Output of the evaluation loop: a normal content change through the builders, --check and CI. Plans: E51.

nodes.label: FALLBACK-POOL-LIBRARY
nodes.title: Fallback: pooled or library case
nodes.text: Planned. When generation cannot deliver a valid, novel case in budget, a validated package from the pre-generated pool or a case from the existing library is loaded… Plans: A2.

nodes.label: OFF-01..10
nodes.title: Offline preparation
nodes.text: Dataset analysis, knowledge base, blocks, packs, retrieval and media indices, prompts, model preparation. Runs before sessions; never inside one.

notes: AI composes, rules enforce: LG-04 proposes the plan (LLM + knowledge-base retrieval); solver, Stage B and cross-modal rules decide validity. Solver-only is the baseline and fallback.
Rules decide state, critical scoring and action acceptance (ADR-0005). Sessions never retrain; the learner profile is updated cheaply afterwards (LP-02).
Colour = status: mint built, sun partly built, blue planned, aqua proposed, coral blocked, grey deferred. Planning only (12 Oct 2026): nothing blue, aqua, coral or grey is built.
